<?php
class CallerBase230 { public $tag=9; public static function capture($saved,$ignored) { echo "CAPTURE:",self::class,":",static::class,";"; return $saved; } public function __destruct() { echo "THIS-END;"; } }
class CallerScope230 extends CallerBase230 { public function run() { global $argument,$owner; $GLOBALS["runner"]=null; echo "FIRST;"; return $owner->MiSsInG(($this->capture(...))($argument,shift230())); } }
class CallerChild230 extends CallerScope230 {}
function shift230() { $GLOBALS["argument"]=new New230; $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class Old230 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New230 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Magic230 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["argument"]=null; echo "HANDLER:",($arguments[0] instanceof Old230)?"OLD;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$argument=new Old230; $owner=new Magic230; $runner=new CallerChild230; $result=$runner->run(); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";
